component.name: 3dfetch
component.summary: Spin your distro logo in 3D with live system info

description.p: 3dfetch turns your distribution's logo into a rotating 3D relief and puts your system info next to it. The logo is turned into a point cloud based on the visual density of its characters and rendered with Blinn-Phong shading, while the info updates live.
The labels are painted in the color the logo is drawn in, so the text always matches the logo next to it. You can drag the logo with the mouse to spin it by hand and let go to fling it.

Every logo fastfetch knows works, so whatever you run you get your own distro's logo. A custom logo in ~/.config/fetch/logo.txt works too, and the fields that are shown can be picked in ~/.config/fetch/config.
Press any key to quit. The keypress passes through to your shell.

ul.li: The info labels take the color of the logo
